links.comparator_used: AI alone (independent AI diagnosis without clinician)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of collaborative workflows vs AI alone
links.effect: Collaborative workflows 85% and 82% were not statistically different from AI-alone accuracy of 90%; performance was comparable across first- and second-opinion workflows
links.quote: Performance was comparable across workflows and not statistically different from AI-alone accuracy (90%), highlighting the potential of collaborative AI to complement clinician expertise.
